title: एनपीएलः नेपाललाई खेल पर्यटनको ‘हब’ बनाउने सम्भावना
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । नेपाल प्रिमियर लिग (एनपीएल)ले नेपाललाई खेल पर्यटनको ‘हब’का रुपमा विकसित गर्ने सम्भावना बढाएको अग्रज खेल पत्रकारहरुले बताएका छन् । नेपाल न्यूज बैंकसँग कुरा गर्दै अग्रज पत्रकारहरुले एनपीएल नेपाललाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा चिनाउने र पर्यटकहरुलाई नेपाल भित्राउने शसक्त माध्यमका रुपमा विकसित भइरहेको बताए । उनीहरुका अनुसार एनपीएलका नाममा मात्रै सयौँ विदेशी खेलाडीहरु र त्यत्तिकै संख्यामा खेल व्यवस्थापनसँग जोडिएका व्यक्तिहरु नेपाल आउने र तिनले विश्वमा नेपालको प्रचार गर्ने सम्भावनाको विकास भएको छ । उनीहरुले भने, ‘पर्यटनका हिसाबले नेपाल एउटा ठूलो सम्भावना बोकेको देश हो । प्राकृतिक सौन्दर्य, हिमाल, धार्मिक तथा सांस्कृतिक सम्पदा र साहसिक पर्यटनका कारण नेपाल विश्वकै आकर्षक गन्तव्यका रूपमा चिनिन्छ । एनपीएल आयोजनाका सन्दर्भमा नेपाल आउनेहरुले यहाँको यही परिचय विश्वभर फैलाउने छन् ।’ अग्रज पत्रकारहरुका अनुसार पछिल्लो समय खेलकुद, विशेषगरी क्रिकेटले नेपालको पर्यटन प्रवद्र्धनमा नयाँ सम्भावनाको ढोका खोल्दै गएको छ । एनपीएलमा सहभागी हुन आउने अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेलाडी, उनीहरूमार्फत हुने विश्वव्यापी प्रचार र क्रिकेटप्रति बढ्दो आकर्षणले नेपाललाई खेल पर्यटनको गन्तव्यका रूपमा स्थापित गर्ने आधार तयार गरिरहेको छ । ‘एनपीएल केवल क्रिकेट प्रतियोगितामा मात्र सीमित छैन, यो नेपाललाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेल पर्यटनको गन्तव्यका रूपमा स्थापित गर्ने सम्भावनायुक्त माध्यम पनि बन्दै गएको छ,’ उनीहरुले भने’ ‘विदेशी खेलाडीको सहभागिता, नेपाली क्रिकेटप्रति दर्शकको आकर्षण र अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा भइरहेको प्रचारले नेपाललाई खेल पर्यटनको हब बनाउने आधार तयार गरिरहेको छ ।’ एनपीएलका विभिन्न संस्करणसँगै अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेलाडी, प्रशिक्षक तथा प्राविधिक जनशक्ति नेपाल आउने क्रमले प्रतियोगिताको दायरा फराकिलो बनाएको छ । यसले नेपाली क्रिकेटको पहिचान विस्तार गर्नुका साथै पर्यटन प्रवद्र्धन, आर्थिक गतिविधि र अन्तर्राष्ट्रियस्तरमा नेपालको छवि निर्माणमा समेत योगदान पुर्याउन सक्ने खेल पत्रकारहरूको भनाइ छ । अग्रज पत्रकार मुकुन्द दाहालले पाकिस्तान र इन्डियाले लिएको उचाइ नेपालले पनि लिनसक्ने भन्दै एनपीएलको तारिफ गरे । ‘एनपीएलले जुन आकर्षण दिलायो, जुन स्तरका खेलाडी नेपालको मञ्चमा आइरहेका छन् यसले नेपालको खेल पर्यटनमा ठूलो योगदान पुर्याइरहेको छ । कालान्तरमा नेपाल खेल पर्यटन योग्य थलो बन्न सक्ने आधारहरु देखिएका छन् । एनपीएलले त्यो स्थापित गर्दै गएको छ,’ उनले भने । अग्रज पत्रकार निरञ्जन राजवंशीले विदेशी खेलाडीहरु नेपाल आएर खेल मात्र खेल्ने नभइ पर्यटकीय गन्तब्यहरुको भ्रमण गरेर प्रचार गरिरहेको बताए । ‘कुनै समय शिखर धवन नेपाल आएर खेल्नुभयो । केही स्थान ट्राभल गर्नुभयो र सामाजिक संजालमा पोष्ट गर्नुभयो । त्यसको धेरै इम्प्याक्ट पर्यो । अहिले पनि टप टप खेलाडीहरु आइरहेको छन् । अहिले नेपालमा आएर खेल्न जो पनि तयार हुँदै गएका छन् । त्यो पब्लिसिटी भनेको त एकदम बिग हो,’ उनले भने । अर्का खेल पत्रकार प्रकाश तिम्सिनाले पनि नेपालले इन्टरनेशनल लेभलको ग्राउन्डको मान्यता पाएकाले खेल पर्यटनको विकास हुनेमा आफू ढुक्क रहेको प्रतिक्रिया दिए । ‘पर्यटनको सम्भावना बढेको छ । किनभने अब नेपालले इन्टरनेसनल लेभलको ग्राउन्डको मान्यता पनि पाएको छ । काठमाडौँमै दुईवटा इन्टरनेशनल लेभलका क्रिकेट एकेडेमी ग्राउन्ड छन् । भोलिका दिनमा यो बृहत् हुँदै प्राइभेट स्तरमा ग्राउन्डहरु तयार होलान । पोखरा र चितवनमा तयार हुँदैछन् । जसका कारण आगामी दिनमा नेपाल एउटा क्रिकेटको हब हुन सक्ने सम्भावना देखिएको छ,’ उनले भने । पत्रकार अजय फुयाँलले पनि विदेशबाट आएका खेलाडीहरु नेपालका पर्यटकीय स्थलहरु घुमेर आनन्द लिने र पर्यटनलाई सघाउ पुर्याइरहेको बताए । ‘एनपीएलका लागि संसारका ठूला ठूला सुपरस्टार वा सेलिब्रेटीहरु नेपाल आइरहेका छन् । उनीहरुले नेपालको पशुपतिनाथ, लुम्बिनी, जानकी धामतिर पुगेर फोटोहरु इन्स्टाग्राममा पोष्ट गरिरहेका छन् । त्यसको प्रभाव विश्वभर पुगिरहेको छ । त्यो भनेको एनपीएलले बनाइदिएको अवसर हो । जसका कारण टुरिज्मलाई फाइदा पुगेको छ,’ उनले अगाडि भने,‘एनपीएलले अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समुदायमाझ नेपालको परिचय विस्तार गर्ने अवसर दिएको छ ।’ एनपीएलको तेस्रो संस्करण आगामी कात्तिक १० देखि मङ्सिर ६ गतेसम्म काठमाडौंको कीर्तिपुरस्थित त्रिवि अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय क्रिकेट मैदानमा आयोजना हुँदैछ । –आकांक्षा Senior sports journalists have said that the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has increased the potential to develop Nepal as a 'hub' of sports tourism. Speaking to Nepal News Bank, senior journalists said that NPL is developing as a powerful medium to introduce Nepal to the international community and attract tourists to Nepal. According to them, the possibility of hundreds of foreign players and an equal number of people associated with sports management coming to Nepal in the name of NPL alone has developed and they will promote Nepal to the world. They said, 'Nepal is a country with great potential in terms of tourism. Nepal is known as one of the most attractive destinations in the world due to its natural beauty, mountains, religious and cultural heritage, and adventure tourism. Those who come to Nepal in the context of the NPL project will spread this identity of the country to the world.' According to senior journalists, sports, especially cricket, have recently been opening up new possibilities for promoting tourism in Nepal. The international players participating in the NPL, the global publicity generated by them, and the growing attraction towards cricket are laying the foundation for establishing Nepal as a sports tourism destination. "The NPL is not just limited to cricket competitions, it is also becoming a potential medium to establish Nepal as an international sports tourism destination," they said. "The participation of foreign players, the attraction of spectators towards Nepali cricket, and the publicity being done at the international level are laying the foundation for making Nepal a sports tourism hub." The arrival of international players, coaches, and technical personnel to Nepal along with various editions of the NPL has broadened the scope of the competition. Sports journalists say that this can not only expand the identity of Nepali cricket, but also contribute to promoting tourism, economic activity, and building Nepal's image internationally. Senior journalist Mukunda Dahal praised the NPL, saying that Nepal can also reach the heights reached by Pakistan and India. "The attraction that the NPL has created, the level of players that are coming to Nepal's stage, is making a huge contribution to Nepal's sports tourism. Over time, the foundations have been seen for Nepal to become a destination worthy of sports tourism. The NPL has been establishing that," he said. Senior journalist Niranjan Rajbanshi said that foreign players are not only coming to Nepal to play games but are also promoting them by visiting tourist destinations. 'Sometimes, Shikhar Dhawan came to Nepal to play. He traveled to some places and posted on social media. That had a lot of impact. Even now, top players are coming. Now, everyone is getting ready to come and play in Nepal. That publicity is really big,' he said. Another sports journalist, Prakash Timsina, also expressed confidence that sports tourism will develop as Nepal has been recognized as an international-level ground. "The potential for tourism has increased. Because now Nepal has also received recognition as an international-level ground. There are two international-level cricket academy grounds in Kathmandu itself. In the future, this will be expanded and grounds will be ready at the private level. They are being prepared in Pokhara and Chitwan. Due to which, there is a possibility that Nepal can become a cricket hub in the coming days," he said. Journalist Ajay Phuyal also said that players from abroad are enjoying visiting Nepal's tourist spots and supporting tourism. "The world's biggest superstars or celebrities are coming to Nepal for the NPL. They are visiting Nepal's Pashupatinath, Lumbini, and Janaki Dham and posting their photos on Instagram. The impact of this is reaching the world. That is an opportunity created by the NPL. Due to which tourism has benefited," he said further, "NPL has given an opportunity to expand Nepal's profile among the international community." The third edition of the NPL is being held from Kartik 10 to Mangsir 6 at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, Kathmandu. - Akanksha Dhami

Senior sports journalists have said that the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has increased the potential to develop Nepal as a 'hub' of sports tourism. According to them, the possibility of hundreds of foreign players and an equal number of people associated with sports management coming to Nepal in the name of NPL alone has developed and they will promote Nepal to the world. They said, 'Nepal is a country with great potential in terms of tourism. Nepal is known as one of the most attractive destinations in the world due to its natural beauty, mountains, religious and cultural heritage, and adventure tourism. Those who come to Nepal in the context of the NPL project will spread this identity of the country to the world.' According to senior journalists, sports, especially cricket, have recently been opening up new possibilities for promoting tourism in Nepal. The international players participating in the NPL, the global publicity generated by them, and the growing attraction towards cricket are laying the foundation for establishing Nepal as a sports tourism destination. "The NPL is not just limited to cricket competitions, it is also becoming a potential medium to establish Nepal as an international sports tourism destination," they said. "The participation of foreign players, the attraction of spectators towards Nepali cricket, and the publicity being done at the international level are laying the foundation for making Nepal a sports tourism hub." The arrival of international players, coaches, and technical personnel to Nepal along with various editions of the NPL has broadened the scope of the competition. Sports journalists say that this can not only expand the identity of Nepali cricket, but also contribute to promoting tourism, economic activity, and building Nepal's image internationally. Senior journalist Mukunda Dahal praised the NPL, saying that Nepal can also reach the heights reached by Pakistan and India. "The attraction that the NPL has created, the level of players that are coming to Nepal's stage, is making a huge contribution to Nepal's sports tourism. Over time, the foundations have been seen for Nepal to become a destination worthy of sports tourism. The NPL has been establishing that," he said. Senior journalist Niranjan Rajbanshi said that foreign players are not only coming to Nepal to play games but are also promoting them by visiting tourist destinations. 'Sometimes, Shikhar Dhawan came to Nepal to play. He traveled to some places and posted on social media. That had a lot of impact. Even now, top players are coming. Now, everyone is getting ready to come and play in Nepal. That publicity is really big,' he said. Another sports journalist, Prakash Timsina, also expressed confidence that sports tourism will develop as Nepal has been recognized as an international-level ground. "The potential for tourism has increased. Because now Nepal has also received recognition as an international-level ground. There are two international-level cricket academy grounds in Kathmandu itself. In the future, this will be expanded and grounds will be ready at the private level. They are being prepared in Pokhara and Chitwan. Due to which, there is a possibility that Nepal can become a cricket hub in the coming days," he said. Senior sports journalists have said that the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has increased the potential to develop Nepal as a 'hub' of sports tourism. Speaking to Nepal News Bank, senior journalists said that NPL is developing as a powerful medium to introduce Nepal to the international community and attract tourists to Nepal. According to them, the possibility of hundreds of foreign players and an equal number of people associated with sports management coming to Nepal in the name of NPL alone has developed and they will promote Nepal to the world. They said, 'Nepal is a country with great potential in terms of tourism. Nepal is known as one of the most attractive destinations in the world due to its natural beauty, mountains, religious and cultural heritage, and adventure tourism. Those who come to Nepal in the context of the NPL project will spread this identity of the country to the world.' According to senior journalists, sports, especially cricket, have recently been opening up new possibilities for promoting tourism in Nepal. The international players participating in the NPL, the global publicity generated by them, and the growing attraction towards cricket are laying the foundation for establishing Nepal as a sports tourism destination. "The NPL is not just limited to cricket competitions, it is also becoming a potential medium to establish Nepal as an international sports tourism destination," they said. "The participation of foreign players, the attraction of spectators towards Nepali cricket, and the publicity being done at the international level are laying the foundation for making Nepal a sports tourism hub." The arrival of international players, coaches, and technical personnel to Nepal along with various editions of the NPL has broadened the scope of the competition. Sports journalists say that this can not only expand the identity of Nepali cricket, but also contribute to promoting tourism, economic activity, and building Nepal's image internationally. Senior journalist Mukunda Dahal praised the NPL, saying that Nepal can also reach the heights reached by Pakistan and India. "The attraction that the NPL has created, the level of players that are coming to Nepal's stage, is making a huge contribution to Nepal's sports tourism. Over time, the foundations have been seen for Nepal to become a destination worthy of sports tourism. The NPL has been establishing that," he said. Senior journalist Niranjan Rajbanshi said that foreign players are not only coming to Nepal to play games but are also promoting them by visiting tourist destinations. 'Sometimes, Shikhar Dhawan came to Nepal to play. He traveled to some places and posted on social media. That had a lot of impact. Even now, top players are coming. Now, everyone is getting ready to come and play in Nepal. That publicity is really big,' he said. Another sports journalist, Prakash Timsina, also expressed confidence that sports tourism will develop as Nepal has been recognized as an international-level ground. "The potential for tourism has increased. Because now Nepal has also received recognition as an international-level ground. There are two international-level cricket academy grounds in Kathmandu itself. In the future, this will be expanded and grounds will be ready at the private level. They are being prepared in Pokhara and Chitwan. Due to which, there is a possibility that Nepal can become a cricket hub in the coming days," he said. Journalist Ajay Phuyal also said that players from abroad are enjoying visiting Nepal's tourist spots and supporting tourism. "The world's biggest superstars or celebrities are coming to Nepal for the NPL. They are visiting Nepal's Pashupatinath, Lumbini, and Janaki Dham and posting their photos on Instagram. The impact of this is reaching the world. That is an opportunity created by the NPL. Due to which tourism has benefited," he said further, "NPL has given an opportunity to expand Nepal's profile among the international community." The third edition of the NPL is being held from Kartik 10 to Mangsir 6 at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, Kathmandu. - Akanksha Dhami

Senior sports journalists have said that the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has increased the potential to develop Nepal as a 'hub' of sports tourism. Speaking to Nepal News Bank, senior journalists said that NPL is developing as a powerful medium to introduce Nepal to the international community and attract tourists to Nepal. According to them, the possibility of hundreds of foreign players and an equal number of people associated with sports management coming to Nepal in the name of NPL alone has developed and they will promote Nepal to the world. They said, 'Nepal is a country with great potential in terms of tourism. Nepal is known as one of the most attractive destinations in the world due to its natural beauty, mountains, religious and cultural heritage, and adventure tourism. Those who come to Nepal in the context of the NPL project will spread this identity of the country to the world.' According to senior journalists, sports, especially cricket, have recently been opening up new possibilities for promoting tourism in Nepal. The international players participating in the NPL, the global publicity generated by them, and the growing attraction towards cricket are laying the foundation for establishing Nepal as a sports tourism destination. "The NPL is not just limited to cricket competitions, it is also becoming a potential medium to establish Nepal as an international sports tourism destination," they said. "The participation of foreign players, the attraction of spectators towards Nepali cricket, and the publicity being done at the international level are laying the foundation for making Nepal a sports tourism hub." अर्का खेल पत्रकार प्रकाश तिम्सिनाले पनि नेपालले इन्टरनेशनल लेभलको ग्राउन्डको मान्यता पाएकाले खेल पर्यटनको विकास हुनेमा आफू ढुक्क रहेको प्रतिक्रिया दिए ।

‘पर्यटनको सम्भावना बढेको छ । किनभने अब नेपालले इन्टरनेसनल लेभलको ग्राउन्डको मान्यता पनि पाएको छ । काठमाडौँमै दुईवटा इन्टरनेशनल लेभलका क्रिकेट एकेडेमी ग्राउन्ड छन् । भोलिका दिनमा यो बृहत् हुँदै प्राइभेट स्तरमा ग्राउन्डहरु तयार होलान । पोखरा र चितवनमा तयार हुँदैछन् । जसका कारण आगामी दिनमा नेपाल एउटा क्रिकेटको हब हुन सक्ने सम्भावना देखिएको छ,’ उनले भने ।

पत्रकार अजय फुयाँलले पनि विदेशबाट आएका खेलाडीहरु नेपालका पर्यटकीय स्थलहरु घुमेर आनन्द लिने र पर्यटनलाई सघाउ पुर्याइरहेको बताए ।

‘एनपीएलका लागि संसारका ठूला ठूला सुपरस्टार वा सेलिब्रेटीहरु नेपाल आइरहेका छन् । उनीहरुले नेपालको पशुपतिनाथ, लुम्बिनी, जानकी धामतिर पुगेर फोटोहरु इन्स्टाग्राममा पोष्ट गरिरहेका छन् । त्यसको प्रभाव विश्वभर पुगिरहेको छ । त्यो भनेको एनपीएलले बनाइदिएको अवसर हो । जसका कारण टुरिज्मलाई फाइदा पुगेको छ,’ उनले अगाडि भने,‘एनपीएलले अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समुदायमाझ नेपालको परिचय विस्तार गर्ने अवसर दिएको छ ।’

एनपीएलको तेस्रो संस्करण आगामी कात्तिक १० देखि मङ्सिर ६ गतेसम्म काठमाडौंको कीर्तिपुरस्थित त्रिवि अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय क्रिकेट मैदानमा आयोजना हुँदैछ ।

–आकांक्षा धामी

Kathmandu. Senior sports journalists have said that the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has increased the potential to develop Nepal as a 'hub' of sports tourism. Sports journalists say that this can not only expand the identity of Nepali cricket, but also contribute to promoting tourism, economic activity, and building Nepal's image internationally. Senior journalist Mukunda Dahal praised the NPL, saying that Nepal can also reach the heights reached by Pakistan and India. "The attraction that the NPL has created, the level of players that are coming to Nepal's stage, is making a huge contribution to Nepal's sports tourism. Over time, the foundations have been seen for Nepal to become a destination worthy of sports tourism. The NPL has been establishing that," he said. Senior journalist Niranjan Rajbanshi said that foreign players are not only coming to Nepal to play games but are also promoting them by visiting tourist destinations. 'Sometimes, Shikhar Dhawan came to Nepal to play. He traveled to some places and posted on social media. That had a lot of impact. Even now, top players are coming. Now, everyone is getting ready to come and play in Nepal. That publicity is really big,' he said. Another sports journalist, Prakash Timsina, also expressed confidence that sports tourism will develop as Nepal has been recognized as an international-level ground. "The potential for tourism has increased. Because now Nepal has also received recognition as an international-level ground. There are two international-level cricket academy grounds in Kathmandu itself. In the future, this will be expanded and grounds will be ready at the private level. They are being prepared in Pokhara and Chitwan. Due to which, there is a possibility that Nepal can become a cricket hub in the coming days," he said. Journalist Ajay Phuyal also said that players from abroad are enjoying visiting Nepal's tourist spots and supporting tourism. "The world's biggest superstars or celebrities are coming to Nepal for the NPL. They are visiting Nepal's Pashupatinath, Lumbini, and Janaki Dham and posting their photos on Instagram. The impact of this is reaching the world. That is an opportunity created by the NPL. Due to which tourism has benefited," he said further, "NPL has given an opportunity to expand Nepal's profile among the international community." The third edition of the NPL is being held from Kartik 10 to Mangsir 6 at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, Kathmandu. - Akanksha Dhami
